candidate_relations.reason: The record supports a specific malignant smooth-muscle tumor, whereas this candidate provides no diagnostic entity.
Solitary fibrous tumor/hemangiopericytoma is distinct from leiomyosarcoma and is not supported by the smooth-muscle immunophenotype including α-smooth muscle actin and desmin positivity.
Meningioma was the preoperative clinical impression, but resection showed an extradural malignant spindle-cell neoplasm with smooth-muscle differentiation, supporting leiomyosarcoma instead.
Leiomyosarcoma is a malignant spindle-cell neoplasm, but this label omits the required smooth-muscle differentiation and specific diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Broad morphologic category lacking lineage-specific diagnosis
